newsitem.title: USA: Personnel Management inks new credit pact.
newsitem.headline: Personnel Management inks new credit pact.

text.p: Personnel Management Inc said Wednesday it signed an agreement with KeyBank National Association, a unit of KeyCorp, to increase its credit facility to $11 million.

The company said the new facility will be used for working capital, acquisition financing, letters of credit and refinancing of outstanding borrowings. The agreement should enable Personnel Management to acquire other companies that would add between $10 million and $20 million to its annual revenues, the company said.
Personnel Management provides temporary staffing services to manufacturers and other businesses. Its shares closed up 3/4 Wednesday at 9-3/4.
